memory_initialization: current class mean + .1*N(0,I)/sqrt(d), seed+1000+class; ball projected; identical all arms
slot_assignment: fixed 0..K-1 shared across all four arms; no Hungarian
frame: global fixed random-orientation ETF capacity K; seed+2000
scope: Reuse saved post-task1 teacher and moment; construct only candidate from unchanged synthetic initialization; audit same fixed teacher
diagnostics: same old/innovation/expanded gradients and empirical responses; every class reported; original decision records used only as published context
queries: old=range(task_sizes[0]); expanded=range(sum(task_sizes[:2])); no future image/label samples used
gradient_relative_error: L2 error / reference L2 norm; denominator <=1e-12 gives null, absolute value always reported
response_distribution: all weighted empirical atoms published; quantiles and abs margin<=0.25 mass; argmax coverage measured directly; no tuning
decision_rule: Report per-class and macro errors separately. Descriptive no-harm flag requires all three gradient absolute errors <= moment+1e-12 for every class; strict benefit means >1e-12 reduction somewhere per scale. This is not classification efficacy or a replacement for earlier gates.
state_persistence: load saved prior state, retain teacher and moment unchanged; save only new candidate privately
model_queries: same fixed post-task1 teacher: old slots and next-stage expanded slots, two CE gradients per class per step
